units.source_text: 公鸡的叫声像生了锈的秋千荡来荡去的声音，他醒了。

en.t: He woke to the sound of a rooster crowing, like the back and forth creak of a rusty swing.
He woke in a rush, irritated and restless.

units.source_text: 他以为天刚刚亮，谁知手表上的指针竟指在十一点十六分上。

en.t: He thought dawn had only just broken, but the hands of his watch were actually pointing to eleven sixteen.

units.source_text: 这么说，原来已经是正午的光线了。

en.t: In that case, it was already the light of midday after all.

units.source_text: 昏暗是因为在这洞底里的缘故，太阳光还够不到呢。

en.t: It was dim because he was down at the bottom of this hole, where the sunlight still could not reach.
